report.scene: A black power bank with a round digital display showing 67 and the printed brand oraimo stands upright in a corner on a wood surface, with colored square overlays in the photo corners.

matching_details: The product is a black power bank, the same kind of product as the recall (center of photo).
differing_details: The brand printed near the bottom front reads oraimo, not HAIARA.
The front has a round digital percentage display near the top showing 67, which the official images do not have.
The lower half of the front has a dotted texture pattern not seen in the official images.
No 20W print and no magnetic ring graphic is visible on the front.
The body is tall and narrow with squared edges, unlike the shorter, rounder official unit.
product.reason_plain: No. This is an oraimo power bank with a digital display, not the recalled HAIARA W5 PRO.
product.reason_technical: Printed oraimo logo, round LED percentage display, and dotted texture conflict with the official images, which show a plain front with 20W print or a magnetic ring. Only the product category and black color match.

actions.evidence: No handwritten or marker writing is visible anywhere on the power bank. The front shows only the printed oraimo logo and the display.

photo_source.reason: The photo shows a real object with natural shadows and grain in a corner setting. The colored squares in the corners look like a decorative filter overlay added afterward, not signs of a screen or printout.

report.retake_tip: Please check that this is the HAIARA W5 PRO power bank, then write recalled on it in permanent marker and take a clear photo showing the writing.
